create_config_my_new_model: create a MyNewModelConfig instance with default hyperparameters for a 7B transformer model
configure_rope_scaling: configure RoPE embedding scaling parameters for extended sequence length support
validate_model_architecture: validate that hidden size is a multiple of attention heads in MyNewModelConfig
initialize_head_dim: initialize head_dim from hidden_size divided by num_attention_heads when not specified
setup_gqa_attention_heads: setup grouped query attention by configuring num_key_value_heads separately from num_attention_heads
